lines.zh: 六条腿踩着草叶，一路向前不绕弯。
lines.en: Six legs press the grass and never think of turning.

lines.zh: 我们排成一线，朝羊群的方向走。
lines.en: We walk in a single line toward the sheep.

lines.zh: 触角碰一碰，前面的同伴就知道方向。
lines.en: A touch of antennae tells the one ahead where to go.

lines.zh: 甲壳刮过石头，发出细碎的响声。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the stone with a thin dry rasp.

lines.zh: 别站在这条路上，我们不会让开。
lines.en: Do not stand in this path; we will not step aside.

lines.zh: 我背上还沾着上一只羊的毛。
lines.en: I still carry the last sheep's wool on my back.

lines.zh: 走得越快，我的颚就张得越开。
lines.en: The faster I walk, the wider my mandibles open.

lines.zh: 地上那团羊毛，我不屑于去捡。
lines.en: That clump of wool on the ground? I leave it.

lines.zh: 同伴的步子和我一模一样，像一条线。
lines.en: My sisters step exactly as I do, one long line.

lines.zh: 我顺着草茎爬上坡，去找下一只羊。
lines.en: I climb the grass stems to find the next sheep.

lines.zh: 我的腿短，但每一步都朝同一个方向。
lines.en: My legs are short, but every step points forward.

lines.zh: 沙沙声不是风，是我们整队经过。
lines.en: That rustle is not wind; it is our whole column passing.

lines.zh: 谁挡在羊圈门口，谁就先挨颚。
lines.en: Whoever blocks the pen gate gets my mandibles first.

lines.zh: 我们不需要巢，走到哪剪到哪。
lines.en: We keep no nest; we shear wherever we reach.

lines.zh: 我爬上羊毛，脚陷进去一半。
lines.en: I climb onto wool and my legs sink halfway.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，湿了脚就不好剪。
lines.en: I go around the puddle; wet feet cut poorly.

lines.zh: 我停下来，只把触角举高探风。
lines.en: I stop, lifting both antennae to taste the wind.

lines.zh: 颚在互相磨，像在磨一把小剪刀。
lines.en: My mandibles grind together like a pair of tiny shears.

lines.zh: 我数着附近的羊，一只，两只。
lines.en: I count the nearby sheep: one, then two.

lines.zh: 闲着的时候我更喜欢想羊毛。
lines.en: When idle, my thoughts turn to wool.

lines.zh: 同伴爬过我的背，我不介意。
lines.en: A sister crawls over my back; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔颚，上面还有羊油味。
lines.en: I lick my mandibles; sheep grease still coats them.

lines.zh: 没有羊的时候，我就盯着草看。
lines.en: With no sheep around, I simply stare at the grass.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时羊会挤成一团。
lines.en: I wait for dusk, when the sheep huddle together.

lines.zh: 我的第六感告诉我，有毛在动。
lines.en: Something in me senses moving fleece nearby.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，试探空气里的气味。
lines.en: I raise a foreleg and test the air for scent.

lines.zh: 这只羊太瘦，我再等几天。
lines.en: That sheep is too thin; I will wait a few days.

lines.zh: 我们安静下来，只有颚还在响。
lines.en: We fall silent, and only the mandibles keep ticking.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我的颚已经张开。
lines.en: You stand too close; my mandibles are already open.

lines.zh: 我从你鞋边往上量你的高度。
lines.en: I measure your height from the edge of your boot.

lines.zh: 你不是羊，但你身上有毛料味。
lines.en: You are not a sheep, but you smell of wool.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你手上有没剪刀。
lines.en: I tilt my head and check your hands for shears.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我会先咬再想。
lines.en: Do not reach out; I bite first and think later.

lines.zh: 你比羊高太多，我得先爬上去。
lines.en: You stand far taller than sheep; I would have to climb.

lines.zh: 我们都在看你，只是没动。
lines.en: Every one of us watches you and none of us moves.

lines.zh: 你的裤脚沾了草籽，我看见了。
lines.en: I notice the grass seed stuck to your trousers.

lines.zh: 对视的时候，我从不先退。
lines.en: In a staring match, I never look away first.

lines.zh: 你脚下再挪半步，我就不客气了。
lines.en: One more step closer and my patience is gone.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了一道，我照样往前爬。
lines.en: A crack in my shell, and still I crawl forward.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我半条腿，我还有五条。
lines.en: You crushed half a leg; I still have five.

lines.zh: 疼让我更想咬住你的脚踝。
lines.en: Pain only makes me want your ankle more.

lines.zh: 我的体液是酸的，溅到你了吗。
lines.en: My blood is sour; did it splash on you?

lines.zh: 这一下没打准，我还在动。
lines.en: That strike missed the mark; I am still moving.

lines.zh: 断掉的那截腿还在草里抽。
lines.en: The leg you severed still twitches in the grass.

lines.zh: 我振了振颚，把疼咽下去。
lines.en: I work my mandibles and swallow the pain down.

lines.zh: 我们不会因为一只受伤就散队。
lines.en: One of us bleeding does not break the column.

lines.zh: 你听见壳碎的声音了吗，很脆。
lines.en: Did you hear the shell crack? It was crisp.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，只是为了再冲一次。
lines.en: I back off half a step only to charge again.

lines.zh: 那团羊毛一动，我的颚就张开了。
lines.en: That wool moves, and my mandibles open wide.

lines.zh: 你别拦我，我只想剪一下。
lines.en: Do not stop me; I only want one trim.

lines.zh: 羊毛的油味让我走不动路。
lines.en: The grease in wool roots me to the spot.

lines.zh: 我看到一只羊，就忘了你的存在。
lines.en: I see a sheep and forget you exist.

lines.zh: 哪怕只是毯子，我也想爬上去。
lines.en: Even a blanket makes me want to climb it.

lines.zh: 让我过去，剪完我就走。
lines.en: Let me pass; I will leave once I finish shearing.

lines.zh: 那只羊在抖，说明毛很厚。
lines.en: That sheep is shivering, so its fleece must be thick.

lines.zh: 我闻到剪毛的季节了。
lines.en: I can smell the shearing season in the air.

lines.zh: 你手里的线团也算毛，归我。
lines.en: That ball of yarn counts as wool; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我的腿自己转向了羊圈。
lines.en: My legs turn toward the pen on their own.

lines.zh: 撞上来的是你，不是我。
lines.en: You are the one who walked into me.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，你的膝盖会先疼。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your knee will ache first.

lines.zh: 别用脚拨我，我会顺杆往上爬。
lines.en: Do not nudge me; I will climb straight up your boot.

lines.zh: 你把我的队伍撞散了。
lines.en: You have scattered my column with your foot.

lines.zh: 我贴住你的鞋，慢慢往上挪。
lines.en: I cling to your boot and creep slowly upward.

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，但我会记住。
lines.en: That was no attack, but I will remember it.

lines.zh: 我们互相挤着走，本来就是这样的。
lines.en: We push and shove as we walk; that is normal.

lines.zh: 你的重量压下来，我在壳里缩了缩。
lines.en: Your weight presses down and I shrink into my shell.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我的颚就在你脚边。
lines.en: One step closer and my mandibles are at your heel.

lines.zh: 撞我那一下，你听见轻轻的咔声。
lines.en: You heard a small click when you bumped me.

lines.zh: 我们不用成对，队伍本身就是家。
lines.en: We do not pair off; the column itself is our home.

lines.zh: 等雨季来了，我们才分巢。
lines.en: Only when the rains come do we split the nest.

lines.zh: 巢里那位才是要产卵的，不是我。
lines.en: The one in the nest lays the eggs, not I.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰她的颚，算是问候。
lines.en: I touch her mandibles with my antennae in greeting.

lines.zh: 这些卵将来都会爬上羊背。
lines.en: Every one of these eggs will climb a sheep someday.

lines.zh: 我的任务只是把毛带回去。
lines.en: My only task is to carry the wool home.

lines.zh: 我们用气味分谁是同伴。
lines.en: We know our own by scent alone.

lines.zh: 你打扰了我们的相会。
lines.en: You have interrupted a very private meeting.

lines.zh: 巢口那圈毛，是我们铺的床。
lines.en: That ring of wool at the entrance is our bedding.

lines.zh: 姐妹之间不需要多余的话。
lines.en: Sisters need no words between them.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的羊毛，我从不带走。
lines.en: Wool dropped on the ground, I never carry away.

lines.zh: 我只取长在羊身上的那层。
lines.en: I only take what still grows on the sheep.

lines.zh: 你捡吧，那些都算你的。
lines.en: Pick it up yourself; that wool is yours.

lines.zh: 落地的毛会沾土，我不要。
lines.en: Fallen wool takes dirt; I want none of it.

lines.zh: 我绕过那团毛，直走向羊。
lines.en: I walk past the clump straight to the sheep.

lines.zh: 剪下来的东西，跟我没关系。
lines.en: What has been cut off is no concern of mine.

lines.zh: 别往我背上放东西，我背不动。
lines.en: Do not load my back; I am not a porter.

lines.zh: 地上那堆毛被风吹走了，很好。
lines.en: The wind takes that pile away; good.

lines.zh: 我们从不搬掉落的羊毛。
lines.en: We never haul away the wool that falls.

lines.zh: 拿走它，别让它绊我的腿。
lines.en: Take it away before it snags my legs.

lines.zh: 那只羊在低头吃草，就是现在。
lines.en: That sheep is grazing head-down; this is the moment.

lines.zh: 我把你记在颚里，晚点再说。
lines.en: I file you away in my mandibles for later.

lines.zh: 谁先动，我就先爬谁。
lines.en: Whoever moves first is the one I climb.

lines.zh: 我找到了一只落单的羊。
lines.en: I have found a sheep grazing on its own.

lines.zh: 你身上那件毛衣太显眼了。
lines.en: That wool sweater of yours is far too obvious.

lines.zh: 我的颚已经对准了你的脚踝。
lines.en: My mandibles have already lined up with your ankle.

lines.zh: 那只羊的腿被草缠住了。
lines.en: That sheep has its legs caught in the grass.

lines.zh: 目标很近，我不需要跑。
lines.en: The target is close; I need not run.

lines.zh: 我选了最慢的那个。
lines.en: I have chosen the slowest one among them.

lines.zh: 你刚才踢我，我记住了。
lines.en: You kicked me a moment ago; I remember that.

lines.zh: 我沿着羊群的气味找过去。
lines.en: I follow the smell of the flock to its source.

lines.zh: 那团晃动的白，就是我要的。
lines.en: That swaying patch of white is what I want.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕圈，找落脚点。
lines.en: I circle your feet, looking for a place to grip.

lines.zh: 你先动，还是我先上。
lines.en: Will you move first, or shall I climb?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的裤腿，一路往上。
lines.en: My eyes crawl up your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 那只羊的毛在风里抖。
lines.en: That sheep's fleece trembles in the wind.

lines.zh: 我不急，等你低头喝水。
lines.en: I am patient; I will wait until you drink.

lines.zh: 我的腿在数距离，一步，两步。
lines.en: My legs measure the gap: one step, two.

lines.zh: 你越退，我越贴得紧。
lines.en: The more you retreat, the closer I press.

lines.zh: 那根绳子松了，羊套不住。
lines.en: That rope has slackened; the sheep can slip free.

lines.zh: 你的手指动一下，我就知道了。
lines.en: One twitch of your fingers and I know.

lines.zh: 我准备好了，就等羊停下来。
lines.en: I am ready; I only wait for the sheep to stop.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变快了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing has quickened; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我弓起身体，把颚张到最大。
lines.en: I bend my body and open my mandibles to the widest.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝，往上一挂。
lines.en: I bite your ankle and hook myself upward.

lines.zh: 颚合拢的那一下，声音很轻。
lines.en: The click of my mandibles closing is very soft.

lines.zh: 你不该穿这么软的裤子上山。
lines.en: You should not wear such thin trousers out here.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的鞋带，你就慢了。
lines.en: I cut your laces, and now you are slow.

lines.zh: 咬一口就退，这是我学的。
lines.en: Bite once and retreat; that is what I learned.

lines.zh: 疼吗，我只有这一种打法。
lines.en: Does it hurt? This is the only way I fight.

lines.zh: 我在你膝盖上找了个缝。
lines.en: I have found a gap at your knee.

lines.zh: 我的颚是剪刀，也是钳子。
lines.en: My mandibles are shears and pincers at once.

lines.zh: 你甩不掉，我抓得很牢。
lines.en: You cannot shake me off; my grip holds firm.

lines.zh: 这一口是为了被你踩碎的姐妹。
lines.en: This bite is for the sisters you crushed.

lines.zh: 我从土缝里钻出来，带着一整队。
lines.en: I crawl out of a soil crack with my whole column.

lines.zh: 新的一窝醒了，先找羊。
lines.en: A new brood wakes up and looks for sheep first.

lines.zh: 我们出生就知道该往哪走。
lines.en: We know where to go the moment we hatch.

lines.zh: 甲壳还是软的，但颚已经硬了。
lines.en: My shell is still soft, but my mandibles are hard.

lines.zh: 这里的羊味很重，我们留下。
lines.en: The smell of sheep is strong here; we stay.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里爬出来，腿有点僵。
lines.en: I climb out of the dark with stiff new legs.

lines.zh: 一队蚂蚁正沿着墙根上来。
lines.en: A column of ants is climbing along the wall.

lines.zh: 刚才这里还没有我们的气味。
lines.en: Our scent was not here a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我们不是来住的，是来剪的。
lines.en: We did not come to live here; we came to shear.

lines.zh: 母巢派我们上来探路。
lines.en: The nest sent us up to scout the way.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发白，我闻到自己。
lines.en: My shell whitens in the heat; I smell myself.

lines.zh: 从羊背上摔下来，我翻了个身。
lines.en: I fall off the sheep's back and roll upright.

lines.zh: 水灌进气管，我的腿乱划。
lines.en: Water floods my spiracles and my legs flail.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进草丛里。
lines.en: The blast throws me deep into the grass.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在树干上，还在扭。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the trunk, still twisting.

lines.zh: 药水味让我分不清谁是羊。
lines.en: That potion reek makes me lose track of the sheep.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，我连干草都想剪。
lines.en: Starving, I would even shear dry hay.

lines.zh: 雷把我的触角烧卷了。
lines.en: Lightning curls both of my antennae.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的腿还在爬。
lines.en: Falling through the void, my legs keep crawling.
